sentences.Når kom du hit, Paul?: When did you come here, Paul?
sentences.Jeg kom hit for tre år og fire måneder s: I came here three years and four months ago.
sentences.Hvordan var det å komme hit?: What was it like coming here?
It was a bit hard at first.
I was alone and didn't know anyone.
sentences.Jeg savnet familien min, og det var mørk: I missed my family, and it was dark and cold.
sentences.Det er ikke så lett å komme til et nytt: It's not that easy to come to a new place.
I often miss my family too.
We got married a year ago.
sentences.Da lærte du vel norsk raskt?: Then I suppose you learned Norwegian quickly?
sentences.Jeg kunne ikke så mye engelsk, men alle: I didn't know much English, but everyone spoke English to me.
sentences.Nå er jeg ganske god i engelsk, men jeg: Now I'm pretty good at English, but I'm not so good at Norwegian!
sentences.Monica kom til Norge for litt over to år: Monica came to Norway a little over two years ago.
They got married a year ago.
sentences.Alle snakket engelsk til Monica, og hun: Everyone spoke English to Monica, and she got good at English.
sentences.Paul kom til Norge for litt over tre år: Paul came to Norway a little over three years ago.
It was hard for him at first.
sentences.Han var flyktning, og familien hans var: He was a refugee, and his family wasn't in Norway.
sentences.Han følte seg ensom og savnet kona si og: He felt lonely and missed his wife and children.
